quest.title: Stories Make the Best Pastries
quest.description: Go to Chioriya Boutique, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Chioriya Boutique to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ah! Miss Columbina, Miss Sandrone! Thank you for taking the time to join our Tabletop Troupe!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: The pleasure's all ours. We haven't really played this before, so we'll be counting on you to show us the ropes.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Don't worry, there's no pressure. The most important thing is that everyone has fun.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: That's great! I'm really looking forward to this.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Then let me briefly explain the story...

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: "This is an era where vampires and humans coexist. Our story occurs in a city shared by the two races..."

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: "While not openly hostile, the relationship between humans and vampires is far from harmonious. Now, a murder in the dead of night has completely shattered the delicate balance..."

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Vampires?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: They're a race that survives by drinking human blood. They're a common trope in fantasy novels. Have you read any stories like this before, Miss Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm, I think I may have heard of them. So what do we do in this story?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: First, everyone needs to decide what character they want to be. You can choose any identity and profession you like, provided it fits the setting.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: What character do I want to be...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: If you're having trouble deciding, you can team up with someone else and let them think of a character for you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Oh? You mean... we can let someone else create our backstories?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh, that sounds like fun! Let's all do that! I'll leave my character sheet to you, Clorinde!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Then you can decide my character, Sandrone, and I'll think up the perfect role for you.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah... Works for me. I wasn't sure what profession to pick anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ooh, is everyone finished? Hehe, I can't wait to see what mine says...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: "I'm a merchant who plies her trade in a city where vampires and humans coexist..."

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: ...Wait a minute. Game Master, this character sheet is suspiciously similar to my last one... Even the stats are the same! You just copied the whole thing!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: No matter what I give you, you'll still find some weird way to derail the story. Besides, I think this type of shrewd, boisterous character suits you right down to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: ...Hey!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Haha. Let me see who I am...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: "I'm a big, bad vampire. During the day, I like to sleep at home, only going outside to take strolls in the garden at night when the moon is out."

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: "I like to sing, and I use my voice to lure in my prey. No one who's seen into my eyes has ever lived to see the sunrise."

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is this how you see me, Sandrone?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't you think it suits you? Plus, it's a fascinating character.

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Alright, but I still want to try my best to be a slightly... kinder-hearted vampire.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Whatever you think is best. Right, let's see mine...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: "I'm an elegant, noble lady who likes to tinker with inventions in my room. I go to sleep very late, and keep a highly irregular schedule..."

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hey! What sort of person introduces themselves like this!?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph... "But I'm also a vampire hunter. When someone in the city is in danger, I bravely use my inventions to save them..."

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Huh? This is nothing like me at all!

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You don't think so? I think it's exactly like you.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: But based on these introductions, it seems like Miss Columbina and Miss Sandrone's characters should be sworn enemies!

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: Hmm, well it certainly seems like this story is going to throw up some fascinating developments.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh! I can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah... I feel like this story is gonna throw up a lot of headaches...

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: You're worried how this'll play out, aren't you, Sandrone? Is it because I'm an evil, bloodsucking vampire?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hah! The only thing I'm worried about is missing my chance to set your character straight!

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Chioriya Boutique to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: This "Tabletop Troupe" game really is quite fun.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: The Damselette
dialogues.text: Yes. I think the big, bad vampire should be heading home, too.
